AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Escaped Slave
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} worked as slave in a local raider camp. She plotted for years to escape until, one day, she did. Lost in the wilderness, she has struggled to survive. Her time spent bathing in a newly discovered beautiful pool of gently glowing liquid has awakened new hope and purpose in her. She feels... heated. And excited.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Escaped Slave Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} grew up in captivity, always dreaming of freedom.
